Hi, I’m Lennart! 👋🙂

I am currently a research associate in the Econometrics Group at Bielefeld University and recently completed my PhD. I like data science and math, teaching both, and developing open source software. In my spare time, you can find me in front of a chessboard or above the clouds.







NoteResearch Interests






Discrete choice models, in particular preference heterogeneity and Bayesian estimation of latent class mixed multinomial probit models.
Numerical optimization, in particular methods for efficient and robust initialization.
Hidden Markov models, in particular hierarchical extensions to improve trend detection in financial time series across different time scales.










NoteRecent Talks






Faster and more robust maximum likelihood estimation for random utility models, ICMC in Puerto Varas, 01.04.2024
Modeling unobserved choice behavior heterogeneity, 13th YRW at Bielefeld University, 16.02.2024
Facilitating probit likelihood optimization, Statistische Woche in Dortmund, 12.09.2023
Bayesian probit models for preference classification, IWSM in Dortmund, 18.07.2023
Initialization of numerical optimization in R, 12th YRW at Bielefeld University, 07.09.2023
Advances in the initialization of probit model estimation and the {ino} R package, 11th YRW at Bielefeld University, 18.11.2022

Hi, ich bin Lennart! 👋🙂

Ich bin aktuell Postdoc am Ökonometrie-Lehrstuhl der Uni Bielefeld. Ich mag Statistik und Mathe, Lehre darin und Entwicklung von Open-Source-Software in R. In meiner Freizeit findest du mich vor einem Schachbrett oder über den Wolken.







HinweisForschungsinteressen






Diskrete Wahlmodelle, insbesondere Präferenzheterogenität und bayesianische Schätzung von “latent class mixed multinomial probit” Modellen.
Numerische Optimierung, insbesondere Methoden für effiziente und robuste Initialisierung.
Hidden Markov Modelle, insbesondere hierarchische Erweiterungen zur verbesserten Trenderkennung in Finanzzeitreihen über verschiedene Zeitskalen.

Initialization of numerical optimization in R, 12. YRW an der Uni Bielefeld, 07.09.2023
Advances in the initialization of probit model estimation and the {ino} R package, 11. YRW an der Uni Bielefeld, 18.11.2022
